name: Logitech Lightspeed mice and headsets (wired)
description: Static colour per lighting zone for the Logitech G mice and headsets OpenRGB drives as wired 'Lightspeed' devices: G502 Proteus Spectrum / HERO / LIGHTSPEED, G403 Prodigy / LIGHTSPEED, G703 / G703 HERO, G900, G903 / G903 HERO and G Pro Wireless on their cable, and the G633, G635, G733 and G935 headsets. The HID++ 2.0 RGB-effects feature 0x8070 and the zones are found with read-only queries; the device is put in software control (OpenRGB: saving to flash off). Devices with only the 0x8071 feature are held back at run time. Adapted from OpenRGB's LogitechProtocolCommon and LogitechLightspeedController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The LIGHTSPEED / POWERPLAY receivers are not claimed. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/logitech-lightspeed.md.
